name: agents-hub
description: Plugins for Agents Hub: pages, themes, skills, helper processes

plugins.name: changes
plugins.description: A "Changes" panel to the right of the session, as in Orca: what the agent changed in the code, by file and line; comments on lines go to the agent in one message
plugins.author: libertyswift

plugins.name: chat-images
plugins.description: Images from the agent show right in the chat: big ones at full size, several in a row as small previews. A click opens the image full screen: page with the arrows, zoom with a click, drag with the mouse
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: choice-images
plugins.description: When a question asks to pick an image, it shows right in the answer option; many images come as a grid with checkboxes, tick as many as you like. A click opens it large, with zoom
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: claude-update
plugins.description: Update Claude Code with a button: "Settings" → "Claude Code" shows the installed and the available version, updates claude the way it was installed (installer, npm, Homebrew) and asks the hub to restart once the sessions are free
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: copy-on-select
plugins.description: Select text in the feed with the mouse and it is already on the clipboard: no Cmd/Ctrl+C needed
plugins.author: tolaysha

plugins.name: dark-optimized
plugins.description: The "Dark+ Optimized" theme: a neutral dark gray background (#363636) and light text, as in Cursor
plugins.author: Scremliss

plugins.name: direction-icons
plugins.description: Every session in the list has its own icon, picked in the session chat with the button to the left of the title: an emoji is the session icon in the hub, seen everywhere (Telegram, other devices). The style (emoji or outline symbols) and color are changed in Settings → Look → Icons, and the icon of
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: gpt-image
plugins.description: Sessions draw pictures on your ChatGPT subscription, no API key and no extra payment: from a description and up to 16 references, the result lands straight in the project folder. Descriptions and references go to OpenAI
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: granola-meetings
plugins.description: Meetings agent for Granola: weekly pulls meeting notes into an archive on disk, answers what was decided and who promised what, preps you for calls and hands agreements to the sessions that own the topic
plugins.author: summers-julia

plugins.name: hide-sidebar
plugins.description: A button with a panel icon hides and restores the hub sidebar, like in Claude. The button sits in the sidebar header: on top it, the avatar and the ☰ menu, below the search at full width; while the sidebar is hidden, it sits at the left edge of the page. The sidebar smoothly slides out and in (with
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: hub-design
plugins.description: A design canvas inside the hub. Point at an element or an area and comment: the designer gets precise edits. Hand edits, tweaks, PDF export, and a start screen with every design you ever made.
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: hyperspace
plugins.description: The Hyperspace theme: dark purple, with gradients on the background, panels, header, footer and buttons, its own icons and avatars; also recolors the dark Clean theme
plugins.author: libertyswift

plugins.name: ios-themes
plugins.description: Hub themes for an iOS developer: Liquid Glass, light, glass over a wallpaper in the spirit of iOS 26; Blueprint, a dark Interface Builder blueprint with an orange accent. Icons8 icons and avatars in the iOS style
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: jira-board
plugins.description: Jira tasks in the hub: what the agents are working on and what is done, the status in Jira, who works on it, a jump to the right session. Statuses come through the Atlassian MCP already connected to the hub
plugins.author: GreatMedivack

plugins.name: mascot
plugins.description: A purple cloud with eyes in the header of the sidebar shows the state of the fleet: waiting for you, working, asleep
plugins.author: kalimullin

plugins.name: mascots
plugins.description: A mascot in the header of the session list, next to the search (in a hub without the ☰ menu it can also replace the avatar), with almost 5000 characters to choose from in Settings → Mascots. The pictures are loaded from petdex.dev, the choice is kept in the browser
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: md-panel
plugins.description: Markdown on a click, in a panel to the right of the session's conversation: the file next to the thread, the thread stays in place; editing, comments and VS Code as in "Files"
plugins.author: kalimullin

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Browser and macOS notifications about what matters to you: a question for you, the hub's answer, a reply to your message, the result of your task, a reminder, a monitor's signal. A click opens the session; an answered question takes its notification away
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: petdex
plugins.description: A pet from the petdex.dev gallery sits on the input field of the open session and shows what it does: working, it runs; asking you, it waves; failed, it is sad; done with a turn, it jumps. Thousands of pets to pick from: "Settings" → "Pet"
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: pin-directions
plugins.description: The pin on a direction in the session list keeps it at the top of the "Directions" block
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: projects-status
plugins.description: "Projects status": a board of apps by stage (Candidate → Development → To release → In the store); every project from hub projects: what waits for your answer, what is going, what is done; a project's card is its memory; a Jira view with who in the hub leads each task
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: quiet-unread
plugins.description: "New" on a session (the blue dot and the "New" section in the "Now" tab) only when the result is addressed to you: a reply to your message, to your task, or the continuation of such a turn. The hub's results always count; in the settings, tick who else lights up on any result (specialists, executors
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: ram
plugins.description: How much memory each session eats: its claude and all its children (MCP servers, background commands, builds), and apart from them the hub's browser and the hub's processes with plugins. A "Memory" view and a label next to the session in the list
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: recent-first
plugins.description: Sessions in the list on the left by their latest activity: whoever just worked or wrote is higher. Within each group ("Specialists", "Executors"…) executors stay under their agent
plugins.author: GreatMedivack

plugins.name: reveal-links
plugins.description: A file link in chat opens it in the hub's Files; Cmd-click (Ctrl-click on Windows) shows the file in Finder or Explorer
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: session-mute
plugins.description: Mute sessions: no blue "new" dot and no "reply?" guess
plugins.author: Scremliss

plugins.name: sidebar
plugins.description: The list of sessions on the left hides behind a button in the header and slides out when you hover over it, as in Jira
plugins.author: libertyswift

plugins.name: sidebar-order
plugins.description: Your own order in the list of sessions: drag a row with the mouse within its group (specialists, directions, executors, asleep, an agent's forks). The browser remembers the order; reset it in "Settings" → "Order in the list"
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: sounds
plugins.description: A sound for a new message to you, and another, more noticeable one when a session waits for your answer
plugins.author: kalimullin

plugins.name: tasks
plugins.description: Everything about one piece of work in one card: messages from different sessions, progress on the acceptance criteria and the main decisions. A new task with the /new-task command, from the key of an existing Jira task too
plugins.author: tolaysha

plugins.name: teams
plugins.description: A "Teams messages" tab: new Microsoft Teams messages in one list (direct messages, mentions of you, chosen channels), with "Take on", "Draft a reply" and "Hide" buttons
plugins.author: tolaysha

plugins.name: tg-posts
plugins.description: Posts to the owner in Telegram one at a time: a queue, one unreviewed post hangs in Telegram, the next one comes after a ❤️ or 👎 or a reply; a reply is a revision (it goes to the session, the next post goes out at once, the new version stands first in the queue); deck cards work the same way: a repl
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: unix-terminal
plugins.description: Hub themes in the spirit of the unix terminals of the 70s and 80s: a calm phosphor and a calm amber, the Terminus font on the whole page, ASCII avatars of the agents (Terminus signs for the common session emoji)
plugins.author: GreatMedivack

plugins.name: video-feedback
plugins.description: Give the hub video feedback: press the camera next to the microphone and, 3 seconds later, the screen and your voice start recording. When you stop, the hub turns the speech and key frames into feedback by points, and the video itself lands as a file alongside. It spends more tokens than text, so sw
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: week-recap
plugins.description: Week: every Monday (at 9:00 or at the first start of the hub - changed in the tab) a recap of last week for you, from all your computers at once: first the insights about working with the hub (what you may not know, what quietly broke, what to improve in how you set tasks), then what was done by the
plugins.author: Eugenius-S

plugins.name: whip
plugins.description: A whip on the model of "Hammer": a handle at the cursor, a flexible lash follows the hand, a crack leaves a welt on the screen, sparks and a sound. Esc puts everything back
plugins.author: ManyLattice

plugins.name: wide-feed
plugins.description: The feed and the input field in a wide column
plugins.author: Scremliss

plugins.name: write-lamp
plugins.description: A write lamp: blinks in the input field (in the title bar where there is none) when an agent writes outside: an MR or PR, a push, a deploy and infrastructure, a write to a database, an MCP with writes; a click shows who and what; at rest it stays gray, without blinking
plugins.author: GreatMedivack
